🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 9, 2026

Sun, in Scorpio, holds a conjunction to Moon, in its fall in the same sign. Two water signs looking at each other: what you own and what you want stop being two questions.

Easier — Naming what you actually want, before naming what it costs.
Harder — Keeping perspective on a thing you are standing inside.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 2-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you from Leo on plain terms, without privilege. Across from you in Libra, Venus holds the other half of the account. Cardinal fire meets a bill. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Sun faces you from Scorpio: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Fixed earth pays to hold on. Venus has not been in Scorpio for four weeks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Libra, Venus agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. The conjunction of a week ago is off it now.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, unsupported in Scorpio. Sun in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. The hold Mercury had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, moves through Scorpio unannounced. Moon squares you from Scorpio, and the cost objects. Fire holds on, and the holding is billed. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. Mercury turned back three weeks ago; the review is still running.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, has the run of Libra and sets its own terms. From Leo, Mars hands you an opening. Cardinal air: the opening move is the cheap one. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. With Sun in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Fixed water: what you hold and who you are merge. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Mars trines you from Leo, meeting no resistance. Fire adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Four weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: help that waits to be asked for. Earth that starts things, started cheaply. Two weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun in Scorpio squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Fixed air: the grip is the expense. The trine to Mars that held two weeks ago has let go.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Scorpio, Sun concedes the point early. Mutable water: two answers, neither expensive. A week ago Jupiter was still held by Moon; that is finished.
